info.title: Hermes Native Client API
info.description: The stable, authenticated API exposed by the Next.js host to native clients. Hermes itself remains loopback-only and this server remains the sole consumer of Hermes run streams.

post.description: A successful response is retained for 24 hours under Idempotency-Key. Retrying the same body and key returns it with Idempotency-Replayed: true.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true when this is a stored response.

get.summary: Replay then follow project events over SSE
get.description: Each run event has an SSE id of runId:sequence. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID or cursor. Sequence numbers are scoped to a run; when the resolved run changes, the server replays it from -1. The stream closes after a terminal run event and clients reconnect with backoff.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Fallback for clients that cannot set Last-Event-ID.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Explicit run returned by POST messages.
